name: Palmer Worm
overview: The Palmer Worm, depicted in Joel and Amos, symbolizes a devastating judgment from God upon His people through natural calamity and destruction of their crops. Joel 1:4 describes the Palmer Worm as the initial agent of ruin, whose remnants are consumed by other destructive insects, illustrating a comprehensive devastation. Amos 4:9 highlights God's use of the Palmer Worm to smite the land despite the people's failure to repent, emphasizing divine discipline. Yet, Joel 2:25 offers hope by promising restoration of what the Palmer Worm and other pests have consumed, pointing to God's mercy and redemptive power.
